SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Senpai, do you already know what we should be 
working on?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Well... when the development begins, there's nothing 
I can help out on, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
You said it before, that I should manage the 
progress of the project. So I gave it a shot.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Oh, well then...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: What role should Gokou-san have?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: A support role.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Kuroneko's good at writing, drawing, and 
programming. But for the bulk of this project, Sena 
wants to handle them all, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
You're... right. If it's possible, I want to give it a try, 
but...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
That's why you're in charge of the tasks a single 
person can complete, while Kuroneko follows up 
with the other tasks.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
That might work. Like maps and backgrounds, or 
the lines from minor characters...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
Yes. And having her focus on the BL parts makes it 
easier for me.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Uhh... yeah... well...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
...Don't just stumble right off the bat. You're making 
me anxious.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
B-But I can't help it, alright? At the time, I didn't 
know if you or Kuroneko would lead the project, 
so I couldn't assign any roles.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...I'll be the support.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Huh?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
The main scripts and illustrations, they'll be done by 
Akagi-san this time.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
Nevertheless, I'll handle anything she can't. For 
example, NPC dialogue, backgrounds, map 
illustrations... I can help in many ways.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I-I see. My bad.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Let's have Gokou-san as support then, what about 
the President?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I think he should be the play tester.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [font_size=28]Huh!? Him, of all people?[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: That's quite a bold decision.

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT:
Evaluating me based off my sense of game 
balance, you're pretty good, Kousaka.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
But don't you see? If you tweak the game based 
on what he likes, the game balance will be 
completely wrecked.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
We'll have him playtest instead, if we do the 
opposite of what he says, we can get something 
good out of it.

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT: ...To think such a method existed!

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: He isn't praising you, President!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: But certainly... that method just might work.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Right?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
It's like he's in the right place at the right time... 
huh?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: W-Why aren't you answering, Kousaka-senpai!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:

completely useless... or involving him at all might ruin 
the game...

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT: I can hear you even if you're whispering, Kousaka.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
Well then. Having him as the playtester won't be 
bad at all.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Play tester? The president!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Hey now, if we take his feedback as a reference, 
won't the game just turn out bad?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
Precisely. We'll get a shitty game if we take his 
feedback. If that's the case, what will happen if we 
do the complete opposite of what he says...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: I see, learning from a bad example, huh?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Ignoring the bad ideas, so the game will be even 
better... I never thought we could use him like that!

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: Great idea, let's go with that!

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT: ...This treatment is just terrible...

TEXT: Okay, our roles are settled then. What about you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
I'm working on the schedule and deliverables. Not 
only that, debugging and other small tasks.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: In that case, we're done with deciding the roles.

TEXT:
Huh? But we haven't decided what I should do 
though?

TEXT:
You already have the important role of becoming 
my model.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
I said it before but, I intend to model the main 
character after you, Makabe-senpai.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
Ah, but if you could exchange passionate gazes 
with the President like you usually do, then that's 
good enough for me.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
I won't ask you to show me how you get roughed 
up by dwarves in reality, I'll just draw it based on 
my imagination.

TEXT:
I already have the rough sketch, wanna see? I

saucy, lolol

TEXT:
Cut it out already, Makabe-kun's life points are 
about to reach 0.

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT:
It's... fine... If sacrificing me will allow Akagi-san to 
make her game fun, even I can...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Look what you done, his spirit is practically leaving 
his body.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: S-S-S-Sorry, Makabe-senpai! I can't believe I just...!

TEXT:

TEXT:

TEXT:

TEXT: ...Sorry, I... did it again, huh...
